demux_video_from_source: demux video packets from a media file using Demuxer with optional time window and bitstream filter
decode_video_packets: decode video packets into frames using Decoder with optional filter graph and decode config
demux_audio_from_source: demux audio packets from a media file using Demuxer with optional time window and bitstream filter
encode_image_to_file: encode a numpy array or tensor as an image file with configurable pixel format and resize options
transfer_buffer_to_gpu: transfer a CPU buffer to a CUDA device using transfer_buffer with a CUDA device config
